mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8.5% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 8.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarterly GDPC1 declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average for six consecutive months signals improving manufacturing activity, boosting earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of six consecutive months where INDPRO > 12-month MA (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a decline in the CPI inflation index for three consecutive months signals a disinflationary tightening cycle, reducing real borrowing costs and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND CPIAUCSL falls for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of three consecutive months where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate above 8.5% and a decline in average weekly hours worked (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals a dual labor market shock, reducing aggregate income and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8.5% AND HOUST declines for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of three consecutive months where UNRATE > 8.5% and HOUST declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average for six consecutive months signals strengthening aggregate demand, boosting earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of six consecutive months where GDPC1 > 12-month MA (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for six consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of six consecutive months where INDPRO < 12-month MA (t-test p > 0.05).
